name: 11-Minute Cold Week
title: Accumulate 11 total minutes of cold immersion per week.
subtitle: Cold Volume
rationale: A bounded weekly total keeps deliberate cold a stimulus instead of letting it expand into a time-consuming hobby.
tierTarget: About 11 total cold minutes per week

evidence.summary: The 11-minute weekly figure is a practitioner heuristic extrapolated from small physiology studies of winter swimmers, not a trial endpoint.

sources.label: Voluntary cold-water exposure health effects review

indications: Two to three weekly immersions are already comfortable.
A structured weekly cap would keep the habit bounded.
avoidWhen: Cardiovascular disease or arrhythmia unless cleared by a physician.
